term: standpoint-local accidental feature and distinct origin roles
definition: A RoleSchema has occurs:B→Feature→Prop, accidental:B→Feature→Prop, essenceProduces:Principle→Feature→Prop and externalFeatureCause:B→B→Feature→Prop. Feature is a repeatable characteristic KIND, not a numerical accident token. The supplied essenceOf:B→Principle is separate data and need not be injective or shared.
note: Analyst partial-case vocabulary. occurs represents a candidate having the selected formal characteristic at the supplied standpoint; accidental classifies its contribution as not completing the relevant essence/being in the intended interpretation, whose application is OPEN. Essence-production is attributed to a represented principle; external-feature causation is a separate ordinary-bearer origin role. Different sorts/roles do not prove that a feature cause exists actually, is distinct from its bearer, grounds existence or is external in every ontological sense. Ordinary differently colored objects orient repeatable features, but no independently defended exemplar of essence-production or universal origin fork is supplied; examples and real causal adequacy remain OPEN. These roles are neither eminent perfection InAct nor old CausesIn/grounding, modal necessity or Ontic.Causes. No transitivity, asymmetry, factivity, well-foundedness or generalization from ordinary efficient production is imposed. Primitive qualitative identity, nonproductive predication, and causes that affect quality without producing bearer existence are serious rival interpretations. Source I42[9] has stronger proper-being/individuation conclusions; it remains a separate unbound source reading.
